treatment_summary: The patient’s uncontrolled hypertension (160/87 mmHg) despite lisinopril 10 mg requires addition of amlodipine 5 mg as per NICE NG136. Primary CVD prevention is addressed with atorvastatin 20 mg once daily, justified by the likely QRISK ≥10% and low HDL (NICE CG181/NG28). Obesity management includes semaglutide, a GLP‑1 RA approved for BMI ≥30 kg/m² (NICE PH48), after lifestyle measures. Monitoring will include BP checks, renal function, electrolytes, LFTs, lipid panel, glucose/HbA1c, and assessment of weight loss. All drug choices have been screened for interactions and contraindications, and pending investigations are noted as assumptions.
